notes.title: Update notes v.1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, it was a hot week! Thanks for your support, we really appreciate it!
We working hard on fixing bugs and just released a new patch for Almost My Flor 1.0.3
It should fix bugs with freeze type of cursor, gamepad on different resolutions, and many other small bugs. Also now you could change the sensitivity of gamepad movement.

If you will notice some other bugs please write them in this discussion:

notes.title: Devlog 10 - Character movement changes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, game development in the finish stage! All locations are ready, remains to fix countless bugs, tests, and polish. 
In honor of this event, we want to prepare a new trailer, can't say exactly how long it will take to create, but hopefully, we will publish it in the near future.

Today I wanted to show you one important change in the final version of the game compared to the prologue. We added the ability to run with a double click for the main character. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/bc172216d795fcbab2748d7d02968655ffaab739.gif

Also, run and walk to the side on a held click. We hope that these innovations will improve the gameplay and it will be even more fun.

https://i.imgur.com/4JdNjaf.gif

notes.title: Devlog 09 - changes in exploration system
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We didn't about our progress for a long time, and I think the moment has come. We thought a lot about our exploration system and decided to slightly change it.

Previously, when you click on any active object in a location, a selection window always appeared and you had to click on one of the options. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/745dcb12be39ad189f5c665c546aea65f8548b8c.png

If this is an item, then examine it or take it. If a person - then examine or talk. We thought that many items cannot be taken and the hero often just says a standard reply, or something superfluous.
Fun fact - in the early stages there were always 3 options at one time.

And now we've added objects that can only be inspected or only taken and they will have special icons on the cursor. Thus, the player will poke fewer times and examine the location faster.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/aa4ab16a2040faaa41675dc34c9e9a2e9e468946.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/4619cbbf3e1ab355cf45e9a982232f750ef2c028.png

Don't worry, the option with simultaneous inspection and taking is still there. For items like that cursor now slightly changed, it has a question mark inside.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568114/a38aba081c7372a150aac6e42457a703be3ee3f5.png

notes.title: The release date postponed to August 2021
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The world of the game is getting bigger compared to the original plans, new heroes, new places and plot twists appear. We have to admit that we need more time to fine-tune the game, so we have to postpone the release of the game until August 2021 in order to give our best, put into the game everything we want, and polish it.

Here are some interesting new locations that weren't on the original plans.
